extension.description: Monitor and manage Claude Code sessions in VS Code: context window, models, token usage, tools, todos, and subscription limits.
viewsContainers.title: Claude
config.title: Claude Hub
config.filterMode.desc: Filter sessions by current workspace folder or show all active system sessions.
config.filterMode.currentWorkspace: Only show Claude Code sessions belonging to the currently open VS Code workspace folder
config.filterMode.all: Show all active Claude Code sessions across the entire system
config.showStatusBarItem.desc: Show Claude Code running status in the VS Code status bar.
config.statusBar.preset.desc: Status bar display preset style (similar to claude-hud).
config.statusBar.contextFormat.desc: How context window usage is rendered in custom mode.
config.statusBar.showProgressBar.desc: Whether to display a mini progress bar (▰▰▱▱) on the status bar.
config.statusBar.showModel.desc: Whether to display model name on the status bar.
config.statusBar.showCost.desc: Whether to display estimated session cost on the status bar (e.g. $0.02).
config.statusBar.showGitBranch.desc: Whether to display git branch name on the status bar.
config.statusBar.showTodos.desc: Whether to display incomplete todo tasks counter on the status bar (e.g. ☑ 2/5).
config.statusBar.showTools.desc: Whether to display active tool name and running duration while Claude is working.
config.statusBar.position.desc: Status bar alignment position (Right or Left).
config.statusBar.position.right: Align to the right side of status bar
config.statusBar.position.left: Align to the left side of status bar
config.statusBar.clickAction.desc: Action performed when clicking the status bar item.
config.statusBar.clickAction.openDashboa: Open / focus Claude Hub sidebar dashboard (Default)
config.statusBar.clickAction.switchSessi: Show session quick pick to switch active session
config.idleTimeout.desc: Seconds of inactivity before marking a session as idle. Set to 0 to never hide idle sessions.
config.refreshInterval.desc: Interval (in seconds) to periodically refresh session files and transcript states.
config.contextLimit.desc: Fallback context window size in tokens, used for unknown models. Auto-detected for Claude 3.5, 3.7, Opus, Haiku.
config.warningThreshold.desc: Context window usage percentage to show yellow warning color.
config.dangerThreshold.desc: Context window usage percentage to show red danger color.
config.fetchSubscriptionUsage.desc: Opt-in: fetch Claude subscription 5-hour and weekly rate limits using the end-user's local Claude Code OAuth credentials. Off by default.
config.subscriptionRefreshInterval.desc: Interval (in seconds) to refresh subscription rate limits.
config.configDir.desc: Custom Claude Code config folder (containing projects/ and .credentials.json). Defaults to ~/.claude.
config.language.desc: Display language for Claude Hub interface and notifications.
config.language.auto: Auto-detect from VS Code interface language
config.todo.preferSource.desc: How the dashboard chooses todos. Default auto (dual): show Task and/or Checklist when each exists; Task wins the primary list if both are present.
config.todo.preferSource.tasks: Tasks only: hide checklist/markdown fill unless project plan_checklist is required.
config.todo.preferSource.auto: Dual mode: show Task and Checklist when present; Task is primary if both exist. Never force-fill the other side.
config.todo.preferSource.checklist: Allow plan GFM checklist and assistant markdown todos.
config.alerts.enabled.desc: Opt-in: show VS Code notifications for context thresholds and idle-with-running-tools.
config.alerts.context.desc: Notify when a session crosses warning/danger context thresholds (requires alerts.enabled).
config.alerts.idleWithTools.desc: Notify when a session is idle but still has running tools (requires alerts.enabled).
command.newConversationHandoff: New Conversation (Claude Code for VS Code)
config.modelPricing.desc: Optional USD-per-MTok rate overrides keyed by model id (input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite). Merges over the built-in Anthropic table.
config.modelAliases.desc: Optional model alias map (alias -> canonical priced model id) for cost estimates.
config.sessionListPageSize.desc: Sessions shown per page in the Hub list (light virtualization).
config.todoTools.enabled.desc: Opt-in: write CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 into the workspace .claude/settings.local.json (env only, no Hub hooks). Applies to new Claude Code sessions only.
